capabilities: Navigate to folders using fuzzy search
Expand the target folder on navigation
Prioritize recently or frequently visited folders in results
disambiguation: Not a file search tool; it searches and navigates to folders only, not notes.
extras: Full documentation is hosted on an external documentation site rather than in the README; the plugin is maintained in the author's free time with donation options.
motivation: The author enjoys navigating to files via search but could not find any official feature or third-party plugin to navigate to folders the same way, so they built this plugin.
problem: Obsidian's file search lets you quickly find and jump to files, but there is no equivalent way to search for and navigate to folders.
summary: Fuzzy-search navigator that jumps to folders in the vault, with visit history and prioritization options.
